guidebook.intro: Plans. Put **ka** before the verb for the future: **Ma ka mu** (I will go).

tips.title: Ma ka …
body: **Drusi ma ka mu Koboko** (tomorrow I will go to Koboko); **Ama ka imba alu** (we will study together).
**Mi ngu e’yo ngo?** (what are you planning?).

tips.title: Ma asi ovu
body: **Ma asi ovu** (my heart is there) is “I hope”. **Ma le** is “I would like”.
**Etu alu** (one day) introduces a dream: **Etu alu ma ka ovu malimu**.

culture.title: Visiting family
body: Weekends and holidays are for visiting relatives in the village, often with food from town.
